title: Change Management: Online Product Marketing Information System (OPMIS) Web-Based
content: This study aims to determine an online product marketing information system that mediates change management between business managers and digital entrepreneurs. SME managers do not use digital media technology as a promotional tool. The total number of participants was 421. A structural equation model was used for the quantitative analysis. The results showed that business managers, digital entrepreneurs, technology, and online product marketing information systems affect change management. Online product marketing information system (OPMIS) and technology are partial mediation variables as novelties in this study. Because until now the SMEs have only used social media and have never implemented an online marketing information system application.
